rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 5-6 (p1-008, p1-011): the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference or a real constraint overrides it; Design Release 2.1 itself works out 'Submitted action required' from the notification's own outstanding items (no ITAHC or health certificate attached, or required identifiers incomplete), DR1's inc-014 and inc-027 are deferral blocks on the animals-frontend dashboard that do not travel to INS (p3-002, p3-003, p3-005) and judge nothing about deriving the status from the notification's own data, and the cross-service constraint (p1-010) only decides where it is worked out, not what counts.
outcome: Missing documents, as Design Release 2.1 works it out: a submitted notification still missing a required document (no ITAHC or health certificate attached), or with required animal identifiers incomplete, counts as action needed. It is worked out in the animals backend from the notification's own record and carried into the INS read model, so 'Action needed' counts and lists the signed-in organisation's such notifications, and each drill-down card shows an 'Action required' tag with '<document> is missing' (or 'Information is missing'). Authority-flagged actions are not part of this; they are added only when an outcome feed from the authorities exists.
